name: Guilds of the Crossroads
text: Step beyond mono-color basics into two-color and three-color synergies across four chapters of tactical Constructed duels.

chapters.name: Chapter 1: The Brass Gate
chapters.text: Learn tempo and board control with Boros aggression against Azorius and Mono-White defenders.

nodes.name: Watchtower Recruits
nodes.text: An orderly white-weenie garrison holds the inner square.
nodes.before: Two colors mean sharper curves, stranger. Let's see if your mana holds up.
nodes.after: Fast steel and burn — you read the combat step well.

nodes.name: Crossroads Market
nodes.text: A traveling guild quartermaster offers supplies before you face the Senate Arbiter.

options.name: Guild Stipend
options.text: Take 85 coins for packs or the Boutique.

options.name: Tactical Primer
options.text: Study dual-color mana curves for 220 XP.

nodes.name: The Senate Bench
nodes.text: Azorius control punishes overextending into board sweepers.
nodes.before: Commit every creature to the table and my verdict will clear the lane.
nodes.after: Disciplined pressure — you held back just enough to close after the wipe.

chapters.name: Chapter 2: The Undergrowth Market
chapters.text: Pilot Golgari Midrange through grindy graveyard matchups where every card counts twice.

nodes.name: Alleyway Informants
nodes.text: Dimir spies trade one-for-one while digging for card advantage.
nodes.before: Information wins wars. Let's see what you keep in hand.
nodes.after: Even with empty hands, your topdecks hit harder.

nodes.name: The Ossuary Broker
nodes.text: Rakdos graveyard engines turn discarded cards into lethal threats.
nodes.before: Your graveyard is only half-used. Watch what happens when death is fuel.
nodes.after: Clean answers at the right moments — you earned passage to the Foundry.

chapters.name: Chapter 3: The Storm Foundry
chapters.text: Chain spells with Izzet Prowess against towering Gruul beasts and blazing spirits.

nodes.name: Timberline Crushers
nodes.text: Gruul midrange slams oversized tramplers ahead of schedule.
nodes.before: Fancy tricks won't stop four-power tramplers!
nodes.after: Two instants and my blocker vanished — alright, clever play.

nodes.name: Skyward Choir
nodes.text: Azorius Spirits contest the stack with flash flyers and tempo counters.
nodes.before: Every spell you cast must pass our chorus first.
nodes.after: You baited the Queller and raced right past our flyers.

chapters.name: Chapter 4: The Crossroads Summit
chapters.text: Step into three-color synergy with Jund Sacrifice to face the Crossroads champions.

nodes.name: The Greasefang Syndicate
nodes.text: Abzan three-color recursion threatens explosive graveyard swings.
nodes.before: Three colors unlock engines no guild can build alone.
nodes.after: Your sacrifice triggers shredded my setup before combat.

nodes.name: Arch-Guildmaster Sol
nodes.text: The Crossroads champion brings tuned Izzet Phoenix spell chains to the final table.
nodes.before: Every guild, every shard, every spell line converges here. Show me your mastery!
nodes.after: Brilliant play. The Crossroads recognizes a true multicolor tactician.
